lockFileMaintenance.description: Off: a lock file refresh can move an Expo-managed native module to a new patch release, which silently needs a new dev client build

packageRules.description: The workflows pin every action to a digest, so one upstream release fans out into a digest update per action; land them together

Expo decides these versions: each Expo SDK pins the React, React Native and native module versions it supports, and `npx expo install --fix` is what moves them. Most carry native code, so any change means a new iOS build and an AltStore reinstall. One group, raised only on request from the Dependency Dashboard, never automerged
Majors of everything else get a review, not an automerge
